changelog: The check for a stream that stops now looks near the end rather than past the opening. Two thirds of the way in was not far enough: an iOS 1080p pair measured on 21 August served its audio at half way and refused it at nine tenths, so the check passed and the trailer would still have stopped - later than a minute in, and just as wrong. It asks at 95% now, and whatever serves that serves the lot.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
